mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own vessels was most worthwhile: it showed why heart muscle needs a blood supply separate from the blood in its chambers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the two vessel loops in successive forced steps felt somewhat repetitive, although the resulting two-loop arrangement was clear.

surprise.text: The coronary connection changed my understanding: blood in the heart’s chambers cannot by itself supply all its thick muscle.
